additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419667-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370011] Iplanet-allOutletsUnavailable CRM:00921001680
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs from this day that you provided and found that in these several times, someone pressed the Emergency button on the charger:
First the E-stop is pressed and as a consequence, the QA26 is tripped. At 10:05 hrs someone rebooted the charger-
2025-04-18T10:05:52.318895+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/76699ec3e24c[739]: PLC-Error-Flag 'PerformingCollaboratedReboot' changed from true - ('Reboot active...EMG stop to all outlets') to true - ('Reboot active...Open CMD to Main Breaker')
But still in the SCB the error flags are active.
I would like to inform you that this error indicates the door may not be properly closed. Could you please confirm if the door is closed? If not, kindly try opening and closing it again. Should the door still not open, it is possible that the sensor is malfunctioning.
FYI-Please find below attached
MLFB-3SE5232-0HC05
for door position switch if it's found faulty.
